title: 采访：演讲会与沟通能力（上）

待核: 尚须与实际原音逐句对应；本稿不附假定时间。
尾部题干来自本年所供解析；实际念题措辞、题号和时序仍须以录音对齐，不能把解析字面差异冒充录音。
程序仅绑定ASR候选，不等于源文或音轨已通过人工核验；须复核本年对齐报告的全部差异及未覆盖ASR段。

sentences.en: Good morning, Mrs. Collins!
sentences.zh: 早上好，柯林斯女士！

sentences.en: Welcome to our studio.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到我们的演播室。

sentences.en: As a distinguished member of Toastmasters International, could you tell us a bit about the background of the organization?
sentences.zh: 作为国际演讲会的一位杰出会员，您能介绍一下这个组织的背景吗？

sentences.en: I am delighted to have that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 很高兴有这个机会。

sentences.en: Toastmasters is an international organization, designed to develop effective speaking and listening skills.
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会是一个旨在培养有效演讲和倾听能力的国际组织。

sentences.en: It was founded in 1924 by Ralph Smedley and it’s headquartered in California.
sentences.zh: 它由拉尔夫·斯梅德利于1924年创立，总部设在加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: What is the purpose of Toastmasters?
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会的宗旨是什么？

sentences.en: Toastmasters has a two-fold purpose: the personal growth of the individual and strong effective communication skills.
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会有双重宗旨：促进个人成长，以及培养扎实、有效的沟通能力。

sentences.en: Then, who is Toastmasters open to?
sentences.zh: 那么，国际演讲会向哪些人开放呢？

sentences.en: And what kind of members do you have now?
sentences.zh: 现在的会员主要是哪些人？

sentences.en: Well, many people think Toastmasters is open only to those individuals who wish to be professional speakers, but that is definitely not true.
sentences.zh: 很多人以为，国际演讲会只面向那些想成为专业演讲者的人，但这绝对不正确。

sentences.en: Toastmasters is open to the public at large.
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会向广大公众开放。

sentences.en: Any individual who wishes to improve his public speaking is welcome.
sentences.zh: 任何希望提高公众演讲能力的人，都受到欢迎。

sentences.en: And also, those who just want to increase their overall self-confidence are encouraged to attend.
sentences.zh: 另外，仅仅是希望增强整体自信的人，我们也鼓励他们参加。

sentences.en: Another question is how can Toastmasters help you in job situations?
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是，国际演讲会能够怎样帮助人们应对职场情境？

sentences.en: By becoming involved in Toastmasters, you will learn different methods of communicating what you really want to say, and equally important, you will learn what your audience expects from you so you can deliver that message to them in a logical fashion.
sentences.zh: 加入国际演讲会后，你会学到不同的方法来表达自己真正想说的内容；同样重要的是，你还会了解听众的期待，从而有条理地向他们传达信息。

w.m: phr.以有逻辑的方式；有条理地

sentences.en: Some people are comfortable around friends, but when they appear before a group they don’t know, they get tense.
sentences.zh: 有些人在朋友身边很自在，可一旦面对一群陌生人，就会紧张。

sentences.en: Our organization helps our members to get calm and organize thoughts, and deliver them in an effective way.
sentences.zh: 我们的组织会帮助会员平静下来、组织思路，并有效地表达出来。

sentences.en: Is Toastmasters concerned with total communication, not just for speaking but other communication skills?
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会关注的是整体沟通能力吗？也就是说，不只是演讲，还包括其他沟通技巧？

sentences.en: Most often, people assume that when you are listening, you are also paying attention.
sentences.zh: 人们通常以为，只要在听，就一定也在留意对方的话。

sentences.en: This is not always true.
sentences.zh: 事实并非总是如此。

sentences.en: Many times people are waiting for their turn to speak and are not really listening at all.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，人们只是在等轮到自己发言，并没有真正倾听。

sentences.en: Toastmasters can develop a person overall in terms of organizing their thoughts, getting input from others and then receiving effective feedback.
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会能够全面培养一个人组织思路、吸收他人意见，以及接受有效反馈的能力。

sentences.en: What do we learn about the background of Toastmasters?
sentences.zh: 关于国际演讲会的背景，我们了解到什么？

sentences.en: What is the purpose of Toastmasters?
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会的宗旨是什么？

sentences.en: Who do many people think Toastmasters is only open to?
sentences.zh: 许多人认为国际演讲会只向哪些人开放？

sentences.en: How can Toastmasters help people in job situations?
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会如何帮助人们应对工作中的情境？

sentences.en: Why in many cases people aren't really listening at all?
sentences.zh: 为什么很多时候人们根本没有真正倾听？

同样重要的是，你还会了解听众的期待，从而有条理地向他们传达信息。
